purpose.value: This procedure standardizes intake of customer card-dispute notices before an investigator reviews them.

required_steps.value: Record the merchant, amount, posting date, customer recognition statement, and available receipt. Create a review item and route it to Card Disputes. Do not promise reimbursement.

exceptions.value: If the customer also reports unrecognized transactions, pause ordinary intake and escalate for possible fraud review.

purpose.value: This procedure governs initial handling of customer card-dispute notices and preserves the human decision boundary.

value: Capture merchant, amount, posting date, whether the merchant is recognized, and supporting-document availability.

A human investigator decides any outcome.

purpose.value: The procedure explains how staff record a reported lost physical card.

required_steps.value: Confirm the customer through approved authentication, mark the card for specialist review, record the last known possession date, and offer transfer to the replacement-card team.

required_steps.value: Record the product of interest and preferred contact channel, then refer the inquiry to a licensed lending specialist. Staff must not quote an approval probability.

exceptions.value: Existing-loan servicing disputes follow the loan-servicing procedure rather than this referral procedure.
